recorded.final_text:
*Yes — Special Collections holds Jefferson's letters:*
- *The University of Virginia Jefferson Papers* (1751–1898, Albert and Shirley Small Special Collections Library) — letters written by and to Thomas Jefferson, plus architectural plans and studies: <https://archives.lib.virginia.edu/repositories/3/resources/1438|finding aid>
- *Extracts of letters about Charlottesville, Thomas Jefferson, and Washington D. C.* (1830) — a visitor's account of the University: <https://archives.lib.virginia.edu/repositories/3/resources/344|finding aid>

This material is used in the reading room at Special Collections; it isn't checked out. The Law, Health Sciences and Nursing archives couldn't be searched just now, so they may hold more.
